select_aspect.prompt:
You are auditing {target_url} for SEO. Iteration {iteration} of 5.

The five aspects to cover in order:
1. On-page SEO (title tags, H1/H2 hierarchy, keyword density)
2. Meta tags (description, Open Graph, Twitter cards, canonical)
3. Page speed indicators (resource count, image optimization clues, script loading)
4. Content structure (readability, heading hierarchy, content length, internal anchors)
5. Internal linking (nav structure, link depth, orphan pages)

Prior findings from this audit:
{recall_summary}

Select aspect number {iteration}. Reply with ONLY the aspect name and a specific list of 3-5 things to check on the page.
